header.title: AI benefits music rights holders and higher-end artists more than it cannibalizes them

s01_bottom_line.text: GS Research argues AI is a net opportunity for music labels and rights holders—used to personalize recommendations, curate content and turn listeners into creators—with monetization expected to flow back disproportionately to higher-end artists, and cannibalization limited to lower-value music.
The article presents AI as an opportunity for labels and rights holders rather than a disruptive threat to premium artists in the near term.

If AI monetization accrues to rights holders rather than displacing them, this is positive for music catalog owners, but the article provides no quantified revenue or margin estimate and names no listed company.
